source: USGS GAP Analysis Program / LANDFIRE, doi:10.5066/F7ZS2TM0
description: Complete 584-class terrestrial ecosystem classification for the Conterminous US. Each ecosystem code is mapped to a terrain mobility class for vehicle traversal analysis.

terrain_classes.grassland: Open grassland, prairie, steppe, or meadow. Minimal obstruction.
terrain_classes.agriculture_pasture: Managed pasture or hay fields. Generally flat, maintained.
terrain_classes.open_woodland: Open woodland or savanna. Trees present but widely spaced.
terrain_classes.pinyon_juniper_woodland: Pinyon-juniper or similar dry woodland. Moderate tree density.
terrain_classes.open_coniferous_forest: Open pine or conifer forest/woodland. Moderate canopy.
terrain_classes.open_deciduous_forest: Open deciduous or mixed forest. Moderate canopy.
terrain_classes.dense_coniferous_forest: Dense spruce-fir, hemlock, or subalpine conifer forest.
terrain_classes.dense_deciduous_forest: Dense mesic hardwood, cove, or old-growth deciduous forest.
terrain_classes.shrubland: Shrubland, scrub, or thornscrub. Moderate obstruction.
terrain_classes.semi_desert_shrub: Semi-desert sagebrush, saltbush, or similar low shrub.
terrain_classes.chaparral: Dense chaparral. Significant obstruction to vehicles.
terrain_classes.desert_scrub: Desert scrub, creosotebush, or sparse desert vegetation.
terrain_classes.alpine_tundra: Alpine tundra, fell-field, or krummholz. Exposed, sparse.
terrain_classes.riparian_forest: Riparian or floodplain forest. Potentially soft ground.
terrain_classes.swamp: Swamp, bog, fen, or peatland. Saturated ground.
terrain_classes.wetland: Herbaceous wetland, wet prairie, or emergent marsh.
terrain_classes.marsh: Tidal or salt marsh. Saturated, potentially tidal.
terrain_classes.coastal_dune: Coastal dune or sand grassland. Loose sand surface.
terrain_classes.barren: Barren, sparsely vegetated, or rocky ground.
terrain_classes.cliff_rock: Cliff, talus, bedrock, or scree. Impassable to most vehicles.
terrain_classes.ice_snow: Perennial ice or snow. Impassable without specialized equipment.
terrain_classes.developed_low: Developed open space or low intensity. Roads likely present.
terrain_classes.developed_high: Developed high intensity. Dense urban core.
terrain_classes.developed_industrial: Quarries, mines, or industrial extraction sites.
terrain_classes.introduced_vegetation: Introduced or invasive vegetation. Varies widely.
terrain_classes.disturbed: Recently burned, logged, or otherwise disturbed.
